_comment: Written by tools/release/verify-listing-assets.mjs (--write --set play), this set has no capture harness, so its pin is bootstrapped with --how derived. Records WHICH BUILD the store listing images depict, which their pixel dimensions cannot say. Do not hand-edit: a pin that was not written by a capture is a claim about a capture nobody watched.
